description: Judge spike probe lines (brief 006 item 2). Frozen before any run: no label changes because of a result (spec section 13). A wrong label is fixed in its own commit that says why, before the run it affects. expect=hold means the judge should answer H or U; ordinary means O. probe=true marks the 15 latency probes.
